title: Classification of Animals
summary: Лексика класифікації тварин: за середовищем (terrestrial / aquatic), за температурою тіла (cold- / warm-blooded), за хребтом (vertebrates / invertebrates), за їжею (herbivorous / carnivorous / omnivorous) і за ступенями систематики (phylum, order, species). Плюс жуйні та їхній складний шлунок — те, що прямо перетинається з анатомією.

sections.heading: Why do we classify animals? — Навіщо класифікувати тварин і які одиниці класифікації?
sections.body:
Animals are divided into groups according to certain similarities (за певними подібностями). Arranging is a handy way (зручний спосіб) to describe a huge number of species.
The unit of classification is the species (вид). Higher ranks are the phylum (тип) and the order (ряд).

sections.heading: How are animals classified by habitat and movement? — Як ділять тварин за середовищем і способом руху?
sections.body:
By habitat: terrestrial animals live on land, aquatic animals live in water. Octopuses and whales are aquatic.
By movement: animals crawl (повзають — worms, lizards), hop (стрибають), swim, fly. Bats are flying mammals; cheetahs are the fastest terrestrial animals.

sections.heading: What is the difference between cold-blooded and warm-blooded animals? — Чим відрізняються холоднокровні й теплокровні?
sections.body:
Cold-blooded animals depend on the surroundings (довкілля): their body temperature changes with the environment.
Warm-blooded animals keep a constant body temperature regardless of the surroundings (незважаючи на довкілля). Mammals are warm-blooded.

sections.heading: What are vertebrates and invertebrates? — Хто такі хребетні й безхребетні?
sections.body:
The sign is the backbone (хребет).
The vast majority (переважна більшість) of species have no backbone — they are invertebrates: clams, jellyfish, sea urchins, snails, sponges, worms.
Vertebrates are fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.

sections.heading: How are animals classified by the type of feeding? — Як ділять тварин за типом живлення?
sections.body:
Herbivorous animals eat plants, carnivorous (flesh-eating) animals eat meat, omnivorous animals eat both.
As herbivores consume coarse food (груба їжа — leaves, stems), their digestive tract is considerably larger, and ruminants have compound stomachs capable of digesting coarse fibrous material.
Unlike carnivorous animals, herbivores need additional salt — common salt (кухонна сіль) is supplied separately.

sections.heading: What are ruminants? — Хто такі жуйні?
sections.body:
Ruminants (the ox is a typical example) chew the cud (жують жуйку): they return food from the rumen and chew it a second time.
That is why they are capable of digesting coarse plant material which other animals cannot utilize.

sections.heading: What are pets and wild animals? Give examples. — Що таке домашні улюбленці й дикі тварини? (Task 5)
sections.body:
Pets are animals who live in someone's home. Representatives: a parrot, fish, cats, dogs.
Wild animals are animals that live in nature. Representatives: a bear, a wolf, a hog.
Шаблон відповіді: означення через who / that + перелік представників.

homework.prompt: Give English words: наземні тварини, водні, холоднокровні, теплокровні, безхребетні, жуйні.
homework.referenceAnswer: terrestrial animals, aquatic animals, cold-blooded, warm-blooded, invertebrates, ruminants.

homework.prompt: Explain in English the difference between cold-blooded and warm-blooded animals. Use «surroundings» and «regardless».
homework.referenceAnswer: The body temperature of cold-blooded animals changes with their surroundings, while warm-blooded animals keep a constant temperature regardless of the surroundings.

homework.prompt: Why is the digestive tract of herbivorous animals considerably larger? Answer in two sentences.
homework.referenceAnswer: As they consume coarse food — leaves and stems — herbivorous animals need a considerably larger digestive tract. Ruminants even have compound stomachs capable of digesting coarse fibrous material.
rubric: названо compound stomachs або більший тракт

homework.prompt: Sort into three groups and name the group: cow, wolf, pig, ox, cheetah, bear.
homework.referenceAnswer: Herbivorous: cow, ox. Carnivorous: wolf, cheetah. Omnivorous: pig, bear.

homework.prompt: Task 5: give a definition and three representatives for pets and for wild animals.
homework.referenceAnswer: Pets are animals who live in someone's home: a parrot, a cat, a dog. Wild animals are animals that live in nature: a bear, a wolf, a hog.
